notes: CBER (Office of Biological Products Operations - Division 1) letter for umbilical-cord-derived cellular products (ProText, CoreText, CryoText Pro, CryoText Plus, SecreText, SecreText Pro) that fail HCT/P minimal-manipulation and homologous-use criteria, making them unapproved new drugs/unlicensed biological products, plus CGMP deviations for aseptic processing/environmental monitoring of products purporting to be sterile. The letter never uses the word 'adulterated' (it cites 501(a)(2)(B) only as the basis of the CGMP deviations, not as a formal adulteration charge), so adulteration is omitted from violation_categories. No FEI or organisms are stated.

expected.issuing_office: Office of Biological Products Operations – Division 1
